Team — forwarding MediCorp's ask. Draft below for the single-paragraph statements they want. Please review and add any technical clarity or references to artifacts. We should attach the retention matrix and the signed attestation once ready.

Draft answers (need edits):
- Retention: request/response logs (including prompts and generated tokens) are retained for 30 days by default for operational troubleshooting and abuse detection; customers can opt-in to extended retention (up to 365 days) under contract; customers can also request immediate deletion via API or support ticket.
- Training: Redwood does NOT use customer data to train or improve base models by default; customers can opt in to model tuning under an explicit commercial agreement; training datasets are excluded and any tunings are performed in isolated projects with customer review.
- Evidence: we can provide a retention matrix, SOC 2 report redactions, and a signed attestation that training on customer data does not occur without consent.

Hi Emma — thanks for the clarification. Please find concise, pull-ready statements below and attached artifacts. If you need a signed PDF attestation, that is queued and attached (see training_audit_attestation_signed.pdf).

Short statements for SIG bundle (feel free to paste):
1) Data retention: "By default, Redwood retains request and response logs (including prompt text and model outputs) for 30 days to support abuse detection, troubleshooting, and SLO monitoring. Customers may request immediate deletion of their logs at any time via the Delete Records API or by opening a support ticket. Under commercial agreement, extended retention profiles (up to 365 days) are available for customers that require longer retention windows for compliance or analytics."

2) Prompt/log storage and KV cache: "Short-term runtime artifacts (such as in-memory KV caches used for active sessions) are ephemeral and are not written to persistent storage by default. Prompt text and request/response logs are stored in encrypted object storage for the retention window above; access is restricted to authorized personnel and audited. For customers who require zero-log guarantees, we offer a VPC/private deployment option where logs can be routed to customer-controlled storage and retention is governed by the customer's policies."

3) Training on customer data: "Redwood does not use customer-provided content to train, fine-tune, or improve our shared base models without explicit, written customer consent. Customers can opt into fine-tuning or retrieval-augmented tuning under an explicit contract, which is performed in an isolated project environment; artifacts of that process are managed per the agreed scope. We maintain audit logs of any training jobs that use customer data and can provide attestations on request."

Attachments provided: retention_matrix_2026-11.csv (retention windows and control owners), redwood_SIG_answers_v1.pdf (expanded answers and mapping to SIG questions), training_audit_attestation_signed.pdf (signed by Security + Legal).

Timeline: signed attestation and finalized retention matrix attached to this message. If you require additional legal language or a longer attestation, Vivek is copied and can provide an executive-signed statement by 2026-12-07.
